fields.label: Description
fields.value: Printed in black ink on white paper is a promotional poster for an African Heritage Festival which took place at Chico State College. According to the CSC student newspaper, Wildcat (4/15/1970), the festival included lectures (including Dr. Nathan Hare, the founder and former chair of the Black Studies department at San Francisco State University), music (Matiwana Manana performing a "Zulu cultural show" alongside African Heritage Dance and Music Ensemble), and an art exhibition that included art from a number of artists shown at Brockman Gallery: Gloria Bohanon, Bernie Casey, Marion Epting, Bill Martin, Charles White, and Milton Young.
